shots.focal_element: Founder in a dark bomber jacket on the left third, talking to camera
shots.what_happens: Medium shot of the presenter in a dark tiled studio with spotlit vintage computers on plinths behind him (shallow focus). He gestures with both hands while starting the comparison line 'Unlike other terminal-based coding products' (w249-w254). In the last frame a rounded light panel edge enters from the right, setting up the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a locked-off medium presenter clip with the subject on the left third and a soft-focus lit background, and start the UI panel slide-in from the right edge in the final few frames.

shots.focal_element: Warp Settings window showing the 'Codebase index' list of repositories with sync statuses
on_screen_text: Account AI Billing and usage Code Teams Appearance Features Keyboard shortcuts Warpify Referrals Shared blocks Privacy About
Warp can automatically index code repositories as you navigate them, helping agents quickly understand context and provided targeted solutions. Code is never stored on the server.
shots.typography: Product UI text: bold sentence-case sans heading ('Codebase index'), regular-weight sans body copy, monospace repo names in rows, small sentence-case status labels with check/warning icons; normal tracking. Likely Warp's own UI font (low-confidence guess: Roboto/Inter-like sans plus a monospace).
shots.what_happens: A large rounded card with a soft pastel gradient border slides in from the right and holds over the right ~60% of frame, framing a dark Warp Settings window with the 'Code' tab selected and the Codebase index list (one repo syncing, one failed, four synced). The presenter keeps talking on the left half while the VO explains codebase embeddings (w255-w267). The UI itself stays essentially static across the 5.6 s.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite the presenter plate on the left and slide a rounded-corner card (pastel gradient frame, dark app screenshot inside) in from the right to cover about 60% of the frame, then hold it static while the VO plays.

shots.focal_element: Presenter standing centre stage, flanked by the large words 'Warp' and 'Drive'
shots.typography: Very large bold geometric sans, title case, tight tracking; the two words sit left and right of the presenter at mid-height, white and flat with no outline.
shots.what_happens: Wide full-body shot of the presenter centred in the studio among plinths of vintage computers. He introduces the team knowledge platform (w268-w288); around the time he names it (w276-w277) the words 'Warp' and 'Drive' appear on either side of him (first visible on the 1:51.000 frame) and hold to the end of the shot. Their entrance animation is not visible at 2 fps.
shots.build_rebuild: Over a locked wide presenter plate, place two huge white bold-sans words at left and right thirds at chest height, revealing them on the product-name word and holding them to the cut.

shots.focal_element: Presenter on the left third in a medium shot
shots.what_happens: A very short (about 0.4 s) cut back to the medium presenter angle; the edge of the light UI panel is already visible at the right edge, so this works as the lead-in frames of the panel slide-in for s026. VO is on 'This includes' (w289-w290).

shots.focal_element: UI card on the right cycling through the MCP Servers, Rules and Warp Drive sharing screens
on_screen_text: Rules enhance the agent by providing structured guidelines that help maintain consistency, enforce best practices, and adapt to specific workflows, including codebases or broader tasks.
shots.typography: Product UI text: semibold sentence-case sans headings ('MCP Servers', 'Rules', 'Warp Drive'), regular grey body descriptions, small sans list-item titles; normal tracking. Font guess (low confidence): Roboto/Inter-like UI sans.
shots.what_happens: The rounded pastel-framed UI card slides in on the right while the presenter speaks on the left. The card content changes in step with the VO list: first the MCP Servers page with running server entries (w291-w293), then the Rules page (from about 1:59, w294), then a Warp Drive sidebar with a share dialog where an email is typed into the invite field, 'Invite' is clicked and the access list updates (from about 2:00.5, w295-w306). A cursor is visible on the sharing screen. Small body text on the MCP Servers and sharing screens is not legible in the contact sheets, so it is not quoted.
shots.build_rebuild: Keep the presenter on the left and a fixed rounded card on the right, and swap its inner app screenshot (MCP Servers, Rules, Warp Drive share dialog) on each listed VO feature, ending with a short cursor-driven invite interaction.
